title: DigiRett AI — rettsområde → domain_id Mapping
description: Maps xAPI Lovdata rettsområde values to DigiRett's 12 legal domains. OUT_OF_SCOPE = not covered by DigiRett v1. Values marked confidence=low require legal review before production use.
source: xAPI rettsområde list (279 values) provided by Sidecar/Rolf Frøysa, 20 May 2026
status: Legal review applied. 2 items pending live xAPI verification (Obligasjoner) / by-design paragraph routing (Næringsrett).

domain_id_legend.NEEDS_ROUTING: Broad tag — resolve by paragraph-level routing, not by this table

notes_for_devs: Use this table to auto-assign domain_id when xAPI returns a document. A document's 'rettsomrade' field is a JSON array — a document may carry MULTIPLE rettsområde values.

Resolution rule when multiple values map to different domains: take the most specific in-scope domain. If values map to multiple in-scope domains, tag the chunk to the primary and flag for paragraph-level routing.
If ALL of a document's rettsområde values are OUT_OF_SCOPE, skip the document — do not ingest.
rettsområde maps to DOMAIN only, not subdomain. Subdomain assignment still requires paragraph-level routing keywords from the taxonomy JSON.

Several DigiRett domains have NO dedicated rettsområde (e.g. D02_MA, D08_MONETARY). Content for these lives inside acts tagged with a broader value (e.g. M&A inside 'Aksjeselskaper'). Reach these via paragraph-level routing, not this table.
Entries with confidence=low are Katrine's to confirm before production.
